messages.content: Monday night was approved, so compare hotels for four nights near the Cary office. I need to stay under $210 a night before tax, and Tuesday starts onsite at 7:30 a.m. I'll use rideshare.
What address or area in Cary should I use for the office? Also, are you checking out Friday morning or staying through Saturday?
Use the Weston Parkway office cluster, near the SAS campus. Check in Monday, October 13, and check out Friday, October 17.

I found four practical options with current refundable rates:

- Embassy Suites Raleigh-Durham/Research Triangle: $204 nightly, about 8-12 minutes by rideshare at 7:00 a.m. Free cooked-to-order breakfast starts at 6:30. Cancel by 11:59 p.m. Saturday, October 11.
- Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh/Cary-I-40: $179 nightly, about 10-15 minutes. Hot breakfast included from 6:00. Cancel by 11:59 p.m. Sunday, October 12.
- Hyatt Place Raleigh/Cary: $188 nightly, about 12-18 minutes. Breakfast is included with this rate and begins at 6:30. Cancel by 11:59 p.m. Saturday, October 11.
- Courtyard Raleigh Cary/Crossroads: $169 nightly, about 15-22 minutes. Breakfast is available for purchase starting at 6:30. Cancel by 6:00 p.m. Sunday, October 12.

The times are estimates and could lengthen with an accident or heavy rain.
Can you compare the full room cost before tax and whether breakfast timing is realistic? I need to be walking into the office by 7:20, not arriving at 7:30.

For four nights before tax:

- Embassy Suites: $816. Breakfast at 6:30 leaves about 25 minutes to eat if you request a rideshare around 6:55. Expected office arrival is 7:05-7:15.
- Hampton Inn: $716. A 6:00 breakfast allows a less rushed meal and a 6:50-6:55 pickup. Expected arrival is 7:00-7:15.
- Hyatt Place: $752. With breakfast beginning at 6:30, I would plan a 6:50 pickup and keep breakfast brief. Expected arrival is 7:02-7:18.
- Courtyard: $676 plus breakfast. A 6:45 pickup would be safer because of the longer drive, so the 6:30 opening leaves little time to order and eat. Expected arrival is 7:00-7:17.
Drop the Courtyard. Saving $40 isn't worth adding a breakfast purchase and the longest commute.

That leaves Embassy Suites, Hampton Inn, and Hyatt Place. Hampton has the lowest four-night rate, the earliest breakfast, and the latest cancellation deadline. Embassy Suites is closest but only $6 per night below your limit. Hyatt falls between them on price, though its morning timing is tighter than Hampton's.
How much difference is there in the ride cost? Eight rides total, assuming hotel to office and back Tuesday through Friday.

Estimated standard rideshare totals before tips or surge pricing:

- Embassy Suites: roughly $96-$136 for eight rides
- Hampton Inn: roughly $112-$152
- Hyatt Place: roughly $120-$168

Even at the high end, Hampton's room savings more than offset its estimated ride-cost difference from Embassy Suites.
Does the Hampton rate have any catch, like prepayment or a different room type?

The $179 rate is a standard room with one king bed, no prepayment, and payment due at the hotel. It includes breakfast and Wi-Fi. Cancellation is allowed through 11:59 p.m. Sunday, October 12; after that, the stated penalty is one night's room charge plus tax. A two-queen room is $189 per night under the same terms.
King is fine. Is there any reason to pick Embassy Suites instead for this schedule?

Its main advantages are a slightly shorter and more predictable drive, larger two-room accommodations, and cooked-to-order breakfast. The tradeoff is $100 more across four nights before tax, breakfast opening 30 minutes later, and a cancellation deadline one day earlier. For a 7:20 office arrival, Hampton is operationally easier despite being a few minutes farther away.
Make Hampton the lead. Don't book it yet because I still need to buy the Monday flight, but give me the exact hotel plan and the deadline I should track.

Leading hotel plan: Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh/Cary-I-40, check-in Monday, October 13, check-out Friday, October 17, four nights in a standard king room at $179 per night. The room subtotal is $716 before tax; hot breakfast and Wi-Fi are included, and no prepayment is required.

Track Sunday, October 12 at 11:59 p.m. local hotel time as the free-cancellation deadline. For Tuesday's 7:20 arrival, breakfast opens at 6:00 and a rideshare request around 6:50 should provide reasonable margin. The hotel remains unbooked while you finalize the Monday flight.
